The search for unique physiological gifts; Thom meets a man capable of squirting liquid from his tear ducts and a man who claims to have heatproof hands.

title: Extraordinary Humans
description:
S01 E08 — Ice-Proof, Bulletproof Man
Thom meets a man who has the ability is to submerge his body in ice, without succumbing to the effects of cold; Thom meets a man who developed a form of martial arts to make him indestructible.
